conditions: controlling interest to interconnect with other CDNs

conditions: at the conduit of the respective CDNs
requirements.source_sentence: The next step is to configure the ‘CDN peering’ protocols at the conduit of the respective CDNs in order to technically support the terms and policies implicitly specified through the negotiated relationships.

conditions: on establishment of a peering arrangement
requirements.source_sentence: On establishment of a peering arrangement, these protocols also allow participating CDNs to exchange information regarding the content availability and assists to redirect requests to an optimal peer.

requirements.text: Request-redirection depends on the content distribution and request-routing policies associated with the content and the specific algorithms and methods used for directing requests.
requirements.source_sentence: Request-redirection in a peering arrangement depends on the content distribution and request-routing policies (specified in the CDN peering protocols) associated with the content as well as the specific algorithms and methods used for directing these requests.

become operational

administer functional policies

requirements.text: Once a peering arrangement is established, all participating parties cooperate in the execution of common goals.
actions: cooperate in the execution of common goals
conditions: once a peering arrangement is established
requirements.source_sentence: Once a peering arrangement is established, all participating parties cooperate in the execution of common goal(s).

requirements.text: When a new peering arrangement is established, an instance of the service registry is created that encapsulates all local and delegated external CDN resources.

conditions: a new peering arrangement is established
requirements.source_sentence: When a new peering arrangement is established, an instance of the service registry is created that encapsulates all local and delegated external CDN resources.

requirements.text: The operations performed by the components of the CDN peering is driven by semi-autonomous logic that ensures content is served reliably through content replication, request-routing and redirection whilst maintaining constant awareness of the health (e.g. load information) of participants.
requirements.source_sentence: The operations performed by the components of the CDN peering is driven by semi-autonomous logic that ensures content is served reliably through content replication, request-routing and redirection whilst maintaining constant awareness of the health (e.g. load information) of participants.

requirements.text: Content replication is performed using a cooperative pull-based approach where participating CDNs assist each others in serving data.
actions: perform content replication using a cooperative pull-based approach
assist each other in serving data
requirements.source_sentence: Content replication is performed using a cooperative pull-based approach where participating CDNs assist each others in serving data.

requirements.text: Thus, content replication is featured through extending it to participating servers from the peers in a given peering arrangement, subject to the available resources they contribute.
actions: extend content replication to participating servers from the peers in a given peering arrangement
requirements.source_sentence: Thus, content replication is featured through extending it to participating servers from the peers in a given peering arrangement, subject to the available resources they contribute.

requirements.text: Load distribution is performed by measuring the load information and disseminating it within individual CDNs and amongst other CDNs using a hierarchical approach, where current bandwidth and resource usage of web servers in a CDN is reported to the CDN gateway (i.e. mediator, PA and policy repository as a single conceptual entity) in a periodic or threshold-based manner.
actions: measuring the load information and disseminating it within individual CDNs and amongst other CDNs using a hierarchical approach
reporting current bandwidth and resource usage of web servers in a CDN to the CDN gateway in a periodic or threshold-based manner
requirements.source_sentence: Load distribution is performed by measuring the load information and disseminating it within individual CDNs and amongst other CDNs using a hierarchical approach, where current bandwidth and resource usage of web servers in a CDN is reported to the CDN gateway (i.e. mediator, PA and policy repository as a single conceptual entity) in a periodic or threshold-based manner.

requirements.text: The gateways of participating CDNs then communicate aggregated load information describing the load of their constituent servers.
actions: communicate aggregated load information describing the load of their constituent servers
requirements.source_sentence: The gateways of participating CDNs then communicate aggregated load information describing the load of their constituent servers.
